value.title: Review 3 — phase-3 close-out (4 rounds to APPROVE)
value.note: The plan's own final review, authored as rows (tk-7172 dogfood). Four rounds: FIX(2) -> FIX(1) -> FIX(2, both promoted from the coder's own honest sightings) -> APPROVE with no findings. Dim-0 mutation gate ran first and blocking each round; every finding's fix was verified by the reviewer re-firing the pre-fix control against the parent commit. Verdict rows below decide EVERY finding.

value.finding: persistSibling wrote the live .md directly and restored only the source on error — a mid-write failure left a drifted partial sibling; controls modeled only all-or-nothing throws.
Full-suite exit bar did not reproduce: 5s-default timeout under load (passes alone) — a load-sensitive flake breaking the claimed 4244/4244.

The round-1 replacement control was vacuous: resetCounts() cleared the cache it meant to count across, so the second scan was necessarily a cache hit — spawnless and constant-counter implementations both passed.

writeDocumentWithSibling carried the identical partial-write class in the dd writer path: mid-write failure could truncate the .dd.md while E452 falsely claimed the document unchanged. Promoted fix-now from the coder's own sighting.
Observed 5s-default timeout in the coder's own loaded run; post-tk-7173 any git-suite flake is a finding. Fixture work sat inside the timed assertions.

value.rationale: 370bb1aa stages .md.tmp+rename; PartialSiblingFs mid-write controls fired pre-fix (3/4, 4th honestly flagged unfireable); reviewer re-fired them against the parent.
931a4c88 root-caused subprocess contention (git ls-files whole-tree scan, 16x tail); fixture-repo move + warmed scan + measured budget; pre-fix 5/6 loaded runs failed, post-fix 20/20 green.

7e515d04 split the seam (resetCounts vs invalidateInventoryCache); three opposite-proofs each failing a different half (cache-free 2F, constant-counter 1F, spawnless-stale-list 7F); reviewer independently re-fired the constant-counter variant.

f9a628a0 stages BOTH halves; shared partial-write seam covers the staging temp by matcher; both public-mutator controls fired pre-fix (2/26, truncated sibling lost its whole Tasks table while E452 claimed unchanged); reviewer reproduced against the parent.

0b18d74b hoisted 10 git children to beforeAll, removed shell children, measured 20s budget (46-child count, 220->139ms); post-fix 8/8 at load ~111. The residual CLASS (14 unbudgeted spawn suites, firing relocates as the bar rises) is prime-ledgered OWNER: NONE — not a reopening.
